Title: MongoDB to Azure Cosmos DB online and offline migrations are now available

Body.Content:
Migrate from on-premises or cloud implementations of MongoDB to Azure Cosmos DB with minimal downtime by using Azure Database Migration Service. Perform resilient migrations of MongoDB data at scale and with high reliability. Provision an instance of Database Migration Service from the Azure portal or via Azure CLI and create a migration project.

Read our blog post to learn more.

Learn more
